name: Autobio Diagnostics Co., Ltd.
summary: Autobio Diagnostics Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, marketing, sale, and service of clinical diagnostic products in China and internationally. The company offers immunoassay, biochemistry, and microbiology products; reagents and instruments; and technical and support, and training services, as well as engages in biology research and development activities.
